scope: Development and review findings retained candidly; none changes the input combat or economy formulas.

runtimeCorrections.initialDiagnostic: New comparison helper incorrectly treated the equipment goldBonus cap as 100%.
runtimeCorrections.actualRule: The engine first caps every *Bonus field at 60%; the later goldBonus=1 cap cannot restore it. Luck overflow and fortune are separate contributions.
runtimeCorrections.correction: Diagnose the real base equipment cap as 60%, suppress a nonexistent gain row, and display the cap notice.
runtimeCorrections.verification: Actual engine stats and two real createChest fixtures: 934=934 in our formal audit and 787=787 in the independent review.

runtimeCorrections.initialDiagnostic: The row initially read as a total with-six penetration coefficient.
runtimeCorrections.actualRule: The helper sums build penetration. Encounters can add further conditional penetration, then the engine caps final penetration at 100%.
runtimeCorrections.correction: Label 含6穿盾; trigger 装备与天赋合计；遭遇加成另计.
runtimeCorrections.verification: Independent armored-variant case has displayed build coefficient 15.5% and actual encounter total 75.5%; final scope text explicitly separates them.

ownTestFixtureCorrections.initialFailure: Some relic replacement expectations failed because relic2/relic3 were empty and the default engine policy correctly filled an empty slot.
ownTestFixtureCorrections.correction: Pass requestedSlot relic to details and slot relic to the actual equip transition when the case specifically tests replacement.
ownTestFixtureCorrections.classification: Test fixture correction, not a runtime bug.

ownTestFixtureCorrections.initialFailure: The identical-traits hypothetical candidate reused an existing inventory ID; the engine correctly resolved the already-owned item.
ownTestFixtureCorrections.correction: Give the hypothetical candidate the unused ID i99.
ownTestFixtureCorrections.classification: Test fixture correction, not a runtime bug.

initialOwnGate.note: Initial failures were observed during implementation; the delivered TAP is the corrected nine-case run. No fabricated initial trace is included.

independentHarnessCorrection: Its first probe also omitted the explicit relic replacement slot in two tests. The reviewer retains the initial failed probe separately.
captureCaveat: The independent first source read observed the two diagnostic issues, but its saved comparison-module capture was taken after their correction. Captured-module tests verify corrected behavior; they are not an archived reproduction of the original diagnostic source.
